content:
emma: FYI nightly scan found glibc CVE in runtime-base:2025-04. propose a tiny rebuild + signed rollout tonight. keeping changes minimal to avoid churn.
ryan: ACK. which pools use that tag? prod + canary?
emma: prod and several staging clusters. target minimal patch only.
sophia: plan: 1) rebuild image with updated glibc 2) generate SBOM 3) sign with KMS-backed cosign 4) canary to labeled pool 5) vuln-scan + smoke 6) promote.
harry: RBAC: build-sa needs cloudkms.asymmetricSign and registry.push. runtime pullers only need access to the public cosign key (we'll store in signed-keys bucket).
emma: CI: trigger rebase job, keep signing out of long-lived agents. prefer ephemeral signer using workload identity.
ci-bot: job started: rebase-3855 -> tag runtime-base:2025-04-rebase-3855
kms-bot: key policy reminder: use asymmetric key, enable audit logs, rotate every 90d, bind build-sa as signer.
sophia: audit: forward KMS AsymmetricSign and registry push events to security-logs (retention 90d for keys, 365d for pushes).
oncall-ops: I can cover 19:00-21:00 PT for rollout. page sec-oncall if auto-rollback triggers.
harry: will open IAM PR for build-sa and runtime-puller storage read. link when ready.
ci-bot: cosign sign OK, artifact pushed with tag runtime-base:2025-04-rebase-3855-signed
sophia: running quick vuln-scan on canary. will post results in 10m.
emma: if scan is green, promote 2% -> 20% -> 100% with gates and auto-rescan. rollback on medium/high findings or >1% error spike.
harry: also add runbook steps for cosign revoke and key rotation in case of compromise.
emma: thanks team — keep updates here during window. :eyes:
